NITRO_FIRST_SUBTITLE: When a profile has Nitro theme colors or a Nitro effect as well as hidden ones, show the Nitro ones.
INCLUDE_COLORS_SUBTITLE: Turn off to hide only a profile effect in the bio code.
EFFECT_SUBTITLE: Pick one of Discord's profile effects for the bio code.
EFFECT_PICKED: Profile effect set to {effect}. Copy the bio code again.
EFFECT_CLEARED: Profile effect removed. Copy the bio code again.
COPY_CODE_SUBTITLE: Paste it at the end of your bio; it is invisible.
COPIED: Copied. Paste it at the end of your bio.
NOTHING_TO_COPY: Pick an effect or include the theme colors first.
